Same, Same, New, New

STS-MS8-L3-13001400-MSVPA-AGS-GBL-02 • MS Visual and Performing Arts: Music Grade 8 • Unity, Variety, and Balance in a Final Composition
Look at the picture. You will answer some questions about it. Press the play button to hear each question. Record your answer for each question. You can listen to your answer and record it again. Click SUBMIT RECORDINGS when you have answered all the questions.
JUST FOR FUN · OPTIONAL
Tonight's round is called Build the Perfect Piece. Each composer is handed four instruments from four different parts of the world and three minutes to arrange them into one short piece. The judges award points for unity when an idea comes back, for variety when it changes, and for balance when no instrument buries the others.
If you could bring one instrument from anywhere in the world into your piece, which one would you choose, and where would you make it come back a second time?
Optional. You do not have to record this one.
1
What is Mei doing?
Look at the picture. Explain what Mei is doing and why she chose that panel. Use exact words, not "thing" or "it".
2
What is Jelani holding?
Look at the picture. Explain what Jelani is holding and why this round gave it to him. Use the instrument's exact name.
3

Look at the picture. Explain what the teacher is doing and what it controls in the piece. Use exact words.
4
Where are these students? How do you know?
Look at the picture. Explain where these students are and name two exact details that prove it.
5
Tell me about the Phrase Wall.
Look at the picture. Explain how the four lines on the Phrase Wall differ. Use exact words for what you see printed.
6
Tell me about what Linh is wearing.
Look at the picture. Explain what Linh is wearing and what her seat tells you about her job in this round.
Record an answer for each question, then submit.
